## zarf dev template

Renders a package template into a generated package definition

```
zarf dev template [ TEMPLATE_FILE | DIRECTORY ] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
zarf dev template --set ENVIRONMENT=personal --set MY_IMAGE=ghcr.io/my-org/my-image:0.0.1
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help                 help for template
      --set stringToString   Set a package template value (key=value) (default [])
      --set-file string      YAML file containing package template values
```
